data.title: NVR (NYSE:NVR) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q1 CY2026 Earnings
data.body: Homebuilder NVR (NYSE:NVR) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales falling 21.7% year on year to $1.88 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $67.76 per share was 14.4% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
